$Comment: Old Jack, the pumpkin-headed host who sets up in the Forgotten Temple while Hallow's Eve runs. A thin Variant: Template_Zig_QuestGiver, shipped by Ziggfreed's CommonLib, holds the whole body (standing, watching, the press-F action), and this file only says what makes Jack look and read as Jack. Modify may name only the five parameters that template declares: Appearance, NameTranslationKey, Weapons, OffHand and DefaultOffHandSlot. Naming anything else makes the game refuse the whole role, and the only sign in game is a host who never appears. Appearance is this pack's own model (Models/Hallows_Eve/NPC/Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack.json). OffHand puts the Jack Shield in his left hand, and DefaultOffHandSlot 0 is what makes him hold it; without it the shield stays stowed. NameTranslationKey is his nameplate, in this pack's npcs.lang. NpcPlacements/Hallows_Eve_Old_Jack_Temple.json stands him in the temple, and only while the event runs.
